EDIT: Okay, I'm going to be AFK for a while, so I'll post some actual serious thoughts. Thought number one, at least two people here are liars, so we're definitely looking for a werewolf as opposed to trying to rule out the existence of one (since only werewolves and the tanner have reason to lie; everyone else would want to help the group). Thought number two, impersonating a unique character is a high-risk gamble; impersonating them before anyone else reveals their identity is silly, since if you wait until others speak then you're more likely to name a character in the middle. Therefore, Nielzabub is probably genuinely the Seer. Thought number three, since the Troublemaker hasn't spoken up, we can assume they're not in the game, since it's in their interest to give us information. Therefore, if we assume that Nielzabub is the Seer then Silverleaf is either a Villager or the Robber (if her card got stolen, though again if the Robber was in the game and took a Villager card then they really should have spoken up by now.), and so either way she's on the side of the light. So that leaves two Villagers, two Werewolves and a Tanner in circulation, most likely; I'm a Villager, so (if you believe me and trust my logic) half of the possible remaining cards are now Werewolves, which is not a bad place to be.

Oh, and if anyone comes forwards as Robber or Troublemaker now, they're probably werewolves.
